# Littodoo

> Littodoo is a free, open-source (MIT) desktop sticky note for macOS and Windows that works as both a to-do list and a mind map. It is offline-first with no account or cloud.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): what it is, install steps, shortcuts, FAQ
- [Shared interface](src/ui.html): the single-file UI used on both platforms
- [macOS shell](mac/main.swift): Swift + WKWebView host
- [Windows package](windows/): Python + pywebview host with native C# window layer
